# Brick Instructions For You

Brick Instructions For You is a LEGO instruction video finder connected to the LEGO Instructions For You YouTube channel.

## Main sections
- /2025/ LEGO 2025 instruction videos
- /2026/ LEGO 2026 instruction videos
- /themes/ LEGO instruction pages by theme
- /search/ Search by LEGO set number, theme, year or set name

## Page purpose
Each set page is the canonical page for a LEGO set and can include:
- All Books YouTube video
- Individual Book 1, Book 2 and Book 3 YouTube videos
- Set number, year, theme, subtheme, pieces and price
- Related set links

## YouTube channel
https://www.youtube.com/@LEGOINSTRUCTIONSFORYOU
